_note: Act III, Saltglass flats after Veit's plate: Grell's copper and Ottilie's bought route are cashed in (betrayals grell_copper, ottilie_route).

say: The salt flats crunch underfoot. At the silent lighthouse two carts are waiting. Neither looks friendly.
A Marrovel coach waits by the lighthouse door. Ottilie Kael lowers the window an inch. Exactly an inch.
